# Invented independent QCOW test corpus

All files in this directory except this notice and the hash manifest are
generated by `generate.py` from invented byte patterns. New fixtures and the
generator are LovelyCarve project content, AGPL-3.0-only. They contain no real
evidence, personal data or upstream libqcow test material.

`plain.bin` is the independent logical cluster oracle. v1/v2/v3-deflate.qcow
use Python's C zlib with a raw 12-bit DEFLATE window, unaligned host offsets,
multiple compressed sectors and no trailing sector padding. v1/v2/v3-aes.qcow
use Python cryptography/OpenSSL AES-CBC with guest sector numbers in the IV,
allocated second clusters and a sparse first cluster. The invented password is
`qcow-test`; this is test material, never a user credential.

v2-deflate-short.qcow and v2-deflate-long.qcow contain complete valid DEFLATE
streams whose logical output is respectively one byte shorter or longer than
the declared cluster. They verify exact output length validation independently.

SHA256.json records exact lengths and SHA-256 hashes. Regenerate with
`just generate-qcow-fixtures` after installing Python cryptography. The recorded
generation environment was Python 3.10, zlib 1.2.12, cryptography 48.0.0.
Other zlib versions may emit different valid compressed bytes; intentional
regeneration updates both binaries and hashes together. Tests do not require
Python, cryptography, QEMU or libqcow at runtime.

The pre-existing ../test.qcow2 remains the MIT-licensed qcow2-rs upstream fixture,
separate from this generated corpus.
